Mrs Patel.zh: Patel 太太 · 街角小店

episodes.title: The Wrong Key
episodes.scene_zh: 你刚到伦敦，拖着箱子站在新家门口，钥匙却打不开门。

lines.en: Excuse me, I think my key doesn't work.
lines.zh: 不好意思，我的钥匙好像打不开。

lines.en: Oh, you must be Lin! I'm Emma, your new flatmate.
lines.zh: 哦，你一定是林！我是 Emma，你的新室友。

lines.en: Don't worry, that door is always difficult. Let me try.
lines.zh: 别担心，那扇门一直不好开。我来试试。

lines.en: Thank you so much. It was a long flight.
lines.zh: 太谢谢了。飞了好久。

lines.en: Come in, come in. Would you like a cup of tea?
lines.zh: 快进来。要不要来杯茶？

lines.en: Yes, please. That sounds perfect.
lines.zh: 好呀，正合适。

lines.en: Your room is upstairs, the second door on the left.
lines.zh: 你的房间在楼上，左边第二个门。

lines.en: It's small, but it gets a lot of sun in the morning.
lines.zh: 不大，但早上阳光很好。

lines.en: Is the kitchen shared?
lines.zh: 厨房是公用的吗？

lines.en: Yes, we share everything except the biscuits. Those are mine!
lines.zh: 对，除了饼干什么都共用。饼干是我的！

lines.en: Ha! Deal. I'll buy my own.
lines.zh: 哈！成交。我自己买。

lines.en: Oh, one more thing. The girl who lived here before left a note in your room.
lines.zh: 哦，还有一件事。之前住这里的女孩在你房间留了张纸条。

lines.en: A note? What does it say?
lines.zh: 纸条？上面写了什么？

lines.en: I don't know. It says "for the next person" on the front.
lines.zh: 不知道。正面写着“给下一个人”。

episodes.next_zh: 纸条里写着一句奇怪的话……

episodes.title: Find the Blue Door
episodes.scene_zh: 第二天早上，你打开纸条，然后去街角小店买早餐。

lines.en: Emma, listen to this. "Find the blue door. Ask for the book with no name."
lines.zh: Emma，你听。“找到蓝色的门。要那本没有名字的书。”

lines.en: How mysterious! Sophie always liked little games.
lines.zh: 好神秘！Sophie 一直喜欢这种小游戏。

lines.en: Sophie? Was that her name?
lines.zh: Sophie？她叫这个名字吗？

lines.en: Yes. She moved to Edinburgh in the summer.
lines.zh: 对。她夏天搬去爱丁堡了。

lines.en: Good morning, love! You're new, aren't you?
lines.zh: 早上好，亲爱的！你是新来的吧？

lines.en: Good morning. Yes, I just moved in next door.
lines.zh: 早上好。是的，我刚搬到隔壁。

lines.en: Welcome to the street. What can I get you?
lines.zh: 欢迎来到这条街。要点什么？

lines.en: A bottle of milk and some bread, please.
lines.zh: 一瓶牛奶和一些面包，谢谢。

lines.en: That's three pounds twenty. Do you need a bag?
lines.zh: 一共三镑二十。要袋子吗？

lines.en: No, thanks. Can I pay by card?
lines.zh: 不用了，谢谢。可以刷卡吗？

lines.en: Of course. Just tap it there.
lines.zh: 当然。在那儿碰一下就行。

lines.en: Do you know a place with a blue door around here?
lines.zh: 您知道这附近有个蓝门的地方吗？

lines.en: A blue door? Hmm. There's an old café near the canal, but it's often closed.
lines.zh: 蓝门？嗯……运河边有家老咖啡馆，不过经常关着。

episodes.next_zh: 运河边的咖啡馆为什么经常关门？明天你还要去新公司报到……

episodes.title: First Day
episodes.scene_zh: 新公司第一天，你被安排坐在一个很爱开玩笑的同事旁边。

lines.en: Hiya! You must be the new designer. I'm Tom.
lines.zh: 嗨！你一定是新来的设计师。我是 Tom。

lines.en: Hi Tom, I'm Lin. Nice to meet you.
lines.zh: 嗨 Tom，我是林。很高兴认识你。

lines.en: Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?
lines.zh: 我也很高兴认识你。你是哪里人？

lines.en: I'm from Hangzhou, in China. And you?
lines.zh: 我是杭州人，在中国。你呢？

lines.en: Manchester. Don't worry, I'm friendlier than the weather.
lines.zh: 曼彻斯特。别担心，我比这儿的天气友好。

lines.en: Ha! I hope so. It's been raining all morning.
lines.zh: 哈！希望如此。下了一上午雨。

lines.en: Welcome to London. Right, let me show you the coffee machine. It's the most important thing here.
lines.zh: 欢迎来伦敦。好了，我带你看看咖啡机。这是这儿最重要的东西。

lines.en: Can I ask you something strange?
lines.zh: 我能问你个奇怪的问题吗？

lines.en: Strange is my favourite kind of question.
lines.zh: 奇怪的问题是我最喜欢的。

lines.en: Have you heard of a café with a blue door, near the canal?
lines.zh: 你听说过运河边一家蓝门的咖啡馆吗？

lines.en: The Blue Door? Old Arthur's place! It only opens on Saturday mornings.
lines.zh: 蓝门？老 Arthur 的店！只有周六上午开。

lines.en: Why do you ask?
lines.zh: 你问这个干嘛？

lines.en: It's a long story. I'll tell you over lunch.
lines.zh: 说来话长。午饭时告诉你。

quiz.q: Tom 说这里最重要的东西是什么？
蓝门咖啡馆什么时候开？

episodes.next_zh: 周六终于到了，可是那天下起了大雨……

episodes.title: Saturday Rain
episodes.scene_zh: 周六一早，你准备出门去蓝门咖啡馆，外面却下着大雨。

lines.en: Emma, can I borrow your umbrella? Mine is still in my suitcase.
lines.zh: Emma，能借你的伞吗？我的还在箱子里。

lines.en: Of course. Where are you going so early?
lines.zh: 当然。这么早去哪儿？

lines.en: To find the blue door. Do you want to come?
lines.zh: 去找蓝门。你要一起来吗？

lines.en: I'd love to, but I have to open the bookshop at ten.
lines.zh: 很想去，可是我十点要去开书店。

lines.en: Actually, it might be the last month for the shop.
lines.zh: 其实，这可能是书店的最后一个月了。

lines.en: What? Why? What happened?
lines.zh: 什么？为什么？出什么事了？

lines.en: The rent is going up again. We just don't sell enough books.
lines.zh: 房租又要涨了。我们卖的书就是不够多。

lines.en: I'm so sorry. Is there anything I can do?
lines.zh: 太遗憾了。我能帮上什么忙吗？

lines.en: That's sweet of you. Just bring me some good news from the café.
lines.zh: 你真好。从咖啡馆给我带点好消息回来就行。

lines.en: I'll try. See you tonight!
lines.zh: 我尽量。晚上见！

lines.en: Take the path along the canal. It's quicker, and it's lovely, even in the rain.
lines.zh: 走运河边那条路。更近，而且下雨也很美。

quiz.q: 你向 Emma 借了什么？
Emma 的书店遇到了什么问题？

episodes.next_zh: 蓝门终于出现在眼前，门却是锁着的……

episodes.title: The Book with No Name
episodes.scene_zh: 你找到了那扇蓝色的门，敲门后，一位老人探出头来。

lines.en: We're not open yet, I'm afraid. Come back at nine.
lines.zh: 恐怕我们还没开门。九点再来吧。

lines.en: Sorry to bother you. Are you Arthur?
lines.zh: 抱歉打扰了。您是 Arthur 吗？

lines.en: That depends on who's asking.
lines.zh: 那得看是谁在问。

lines.en: I live in Sophie's old room. She left me a note.
lines.zh: 我住在 Sophie 原来的房间。她给我留了张纸条。

lines.en: Sophie! Well, why didn't you say so? Come in out of the rain.
lines.zh: Sophie！哎呀，你怎么不早说？快进来避避雨。

lines.en: The note says, "Ask for the book with no name."
lines.zh: 纸条上说：“要那本没有名字的书。”

lines.en: Ah, yes. She left it with me before she went to Scotland. Here you are.
lines.zh: 啊，对。她去苏格兰之前把它放在我这儿了。给你。

lines.en: It's a notebook. It's full of recipes and drawings.
lines.zh: 是个笔记本。里面全是菜谱和画。

lines.en: Sophie used to cook here on Saturdays. People came from all over London.
lines.zh: Sophie 以前周六在这儿做饭。人们从伦敦各地赶来。

lines.en: Why did she leave it for a stranger?
lines.zh: 她为什么把它留给一个陌生人？

lines.en: She said the next person would need it more than she did. Read the last page.
lines.zh: 她说下一个人会比她更需要它。看最后一页。

quiz.q: 那本“没有名字的书”是什么？
options: 装满菜谱和画的笔记本

quiz.q: Sophie 以前周六在咖啡馆做什么？

episodes.next_zh: 最后一页上写着一个计划……可你偏偏在这时候病倒了。

episodes.title: Under the Weather
episodes.scene_zh: 淋了雨，你发烧了。周一早上，你给 Tom 打电话请假，又去看了家庭医生。

lines.en: Hi Tom, I'm afraid I'm not feeling very well today.
lines.zh: 嗨 Tom，恐怕我今天不太舒服。

lines.en: Oh no, you sound terrible. Is it the rain from Saturday?
lines.zh: 哎呀，你声音听起来很糟。是周六淋雨了吧？

lines.en: Probably. I've got a sore throat and a bit of a temperature.
lines.zh: 可能吧。我嗓子疼，还有点发烧。

lines.en: Stay at home. I'll tell the boss and cover your meeting.
lines.zh: 待在家吧。我跟老板说，你的会我来顶。

lines.en: You're a lifesaver. Thank you.
lines.zh: 你真是救星。谢谢。

lines.en: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment with a doctor, please.
lines.zh: 您好，我想预约看医生。

lines.en: Lin? It's me, love. I work on reception here on Mondays.
lines.zh: 林？是我呀，亲爱的。我周一在这儿当前台。

lines.en: Mrs Patel! I didn't know you worked here too.
lines.zh: Patel 太太！我不知道您也在这儿上班。

lines.en: Everyone on this street has three jobs. There's a free slot at eleven fifteen.
lines.zh: 这条街上每个人都打三份工。十一点一刻有空位。

lines.en: That's great. Do I need to bring anything?
lines.zh: 太好了。需要带什么吗？

lines.en: Just yourself. And drink lots of water before you come.
lines.zh: 人来就行。来之前多喝水。

lines.en: I will. By the way, I found the blue door.
lines.zh: 好的。对了，我找到蓝门了。

lines.en: Did you now? Then you'd better get well quickly. Something tells me you'll be busy.
lines.zh: 是吗？那你得快点好起来。我有预感你要忙起来了。

episodes.next_zh: 病好以后，你终于读懂了笔记本最后一页的计划。

episodes.title: The Last Page
episodes.scene_zh: 晚上，你在厨房把笔记本的最后一页读给 Emma 听。

lines.en: Listen. "If a place you love is in trouble, invite people to dinner. Stories bring people together."
lines.zh: 你听。“如果你爱的地方有了麻烦，就请大家来吃饭。故事会把人们聚到一起。”

lines.en: That's lovely. But what does it have to do with us?
lines.zh: 说得真好。可这跟我们有什么关系？

lines.en: What if we held a reading night at your bookshop, with food from this notebook?
lines.zh: 要是我们在你的书店办一个读书夜，用这本笔记里的菜呢？

lines.en: A reading night? Do you really think people would come?
lines.zh: 读书夜？你真觉得会有人来吗？

lines.en: If we sell tickets, the money could help with the rent.
lines.zh: 如果我们卖票，这笔钱可以帮着交房租。

lines.en: It's a brilliant idea, but I've never organised anything like that.
lines.zh: 这主意太棒了，可我从没组织过这种事。

lines.en: Neither have I. But Tom is great at talking to people, and Arthur has a kitchen.
lines.zh: 我也没有。不过 Tom 特别会跟人打交道，Arthur 有厨房。

lines.en: And Mrs Patel knows absolutely everyone in Camden.
lines.zh: Patel 太太认识卡姆登所有的人。

lines.en: So we already have a team. When could we do it?
lines.zh: 那我们已经有一个团队了。什么时候能办？

lines.en: The rent is due at the end of the month. That gives us three weeks.
lines.zh: 房租月底到期。我们有三个星期。

lines.en: Three weeks. That's tight, but it's possible.
lines.zh: 三个星期。挺紧的，但做得到。

lines.en: Lin, you've only been here for two weeks, and you're already saving my shop.
lines.zh: 林，你才来两个星期，就已经在拯救我的书店了。

quiz.q: 最后一页的建议是什么？
你想在书店办什么活动？

episodes.next_zh: 要办活动，就得先在公司做一次让你紧张的演讲……

episodes.title: Not Bad at All
episodes.scene_zh: 你在公司做了第一次演讲，结束后 Tom 的一句话让你很困惑。

lines.en: So, how was my presentation? Be honest.
lines.zh: 那么，我的演讲怎么样？说实话。

lines.en: Honestly? Not bad.
lines.zh: 说实话？不差。

lines.en: Just "not bad"? Was it really that boring?
lines.zh: 就“不差”？真有那么无聊吗？

lines.en: No, no! In Manchester, "not bad" means it was really good.
lines.zh: 不不！在曼彻斯特，“不差”就是很好的意思。

lines.en: Then why didn't you just say "really good"?
lines.zh: 那你为什么不直接说“很好”？

lines.en: Because I'm British. We're not allowed to be too excited.
lines.zh: 因为我是英国人。我们不许太激动。

lines.en: That explains a lot. Emma said my cooking was "quite nice" yesterday.
lines.zh: 这就说得通了。Emma 昨天说我做的菜“挺不错”。

lines.en: "Quite nice" is a bit worrying, to be honest. What did you cook?
lines.zh: 说实话，“挺不错”有点让人担心。你做了什么？

lines.en: A recipe from Sophie's notebook. We're practising for the reading night.
lines.zh: Sophie 笔记里的一道菜。我们在为读书夜练习。

lines.en: Right, the famous reading night. How can I help?
lines.zh: 对，那个著名的读书夜。我能帮什么？

lines.en: Could you design the posters with me and share them online?
lines.zh: 你能和我一起设计海报，再发到网上吗？

lines.en: I'd be delighted. And this time, I really mean it.
lines.zh: 非常乐意。这次我是真心的。

quiz.q: Tom 说的 "not bad" 实际上是什么意思？
你请 Tom 帮什么忙？
Emma 怎么评价你做的菜？

episodes.next_zh: 海报发出去了，可是第二天，你们只卖出了三张票。

episodes.title: Only Three Tickets
episodes.scene_zh: 离读书夜只剩一周，票卖得很差。大家在蓝门咖啡馆开紧急会议。

lines.en: Only three tickets. And one of them was my mum.
lines.zh: 才三张票。其中一张还是我妈买的。

lines.en: The posters looked great online, but nobody clicked on the link.
lines.zh: 海报在网上看着挺好，可是没人点链接。

lines.en: In my experience, people don't buy tickets. They follow a story.
lines.zh: 按我的经验，人们不是来买票的，是跟着故事来的。

lines.en: What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: 您这话是什么意思？

lines.en: Tell them why it matters. Tell them about Sophie, and the note, and the shop.
lines.zh: 告诉他们为什么这件事重要。讲讲 Sophie、纸条，还有书店。

lines.en: And put a poster in my shop window. Half of Camden buys milk from me.
lines.zh: 再在我店的橱窗里贴张海报。半个卡姆登都在我这儿买牛奶。

lines.en: Maybe I could write the story myself, in simple English, and share it tonight.
lines.zh: 也许我可以自己把这个故事用简单的英语写出来，今晚发出去。

lines.en: Would you? Your English has improved so much since you arrived.
lines.zh: 你愿意吗？你来了以后英语进步太多了。

lines.en: Thanks. I've been writing a diary every day. It really helps.
lines.zh: 谢谢。我每天都写日记，真的很有用。

lines.en: Then it's settled. Lin writes, I share, and Mrs Patel tells the whole street.
lines.zh: 那就这么定了。林来写，我来转，Patel 太太告诉整条街。

lines.en: And I'll make the scones. Nobody says no to my scones.
lines.zh: 我来做司康饼。没人能拒绝我的司康饼。

quiz.q: Arthur 认为人们为什么会来？
options: 因为一个打动人的故事

quiz.q: Patel 太太提议把海报贴在哪儿？
你说什么对你的英语帮助很大？

episodes.next_zh: 故事发出去的那一夜，你几乎没睡。读书夜，终于到了。

episodes.title: Reading Night
episodes.scene_zh: 读书夜当晚，书店里挤满了人。开场前，门口出现了一个熟悉又陌生的身影。

lines.en: Lin, look! There must be a hundred people here!
lines.zh: 林，快看！这儿得有一百个人！

lines.en: I can't believe it. The story was shared more than two thousand times.
lines.zh: 真不敢相信。那个故事被转发了两千多次。

lines.en: Excuse me. Is this the reading night from the blue door story?
lines.zh: 打扰一下。这就是蓝门故事里的读书夜吗？

lines.en: Sophie! You came all the way from Edinburgh!
lines.zh: Sophie！你从爱丁堡大老远赶来了！

lines.en: Of course. Someone found my notebook and actually used it. I had to meet them.
lines.zh: 当然。有人找到了我的笔记本，还真的用上了。我一定得见见这个人。

lines.en: Hi, I'm Lin. Thank you for the note. It changed my first month in London.
lines.zh: 嗨，我是林。谢谢你的纸条。它改变了我在伦敦的第一个月。

lines.en: No, thank you. You did the hard part. I just wrote a few recipes.
lines.zh: 不，该我谢你。难的部分是你做的。我只是写了几个菜谱。

lines.en: Everyone, can I have your attention, please? Thanks to all of you, the shop is staying open!
lines.zh: 各位，请注意一下好吗？多亏了大家，书店能继续开下去了！

lines.en: Now that's what I call really good. Not just not bad.
lines.zh: 这才叫真的很好。不只是“不差”。

lines.en: When I arrived, I couldn't even open the front door. Now this street feels like home.
lines.zh: 我刚来的时候连大门都打不开。现在这条街感觉就像家。

lines.en: Then you're ready for the next adventure. Have you ever been to Edinburgh?
lines.zh: 那你已经准备好下一场冒险了。你去过爱丁堡吗？

lines.en: Not yet. But something tells me I'm going to.
lines.zh: 还没有。但我有预感，我会去的。

episodes.next_zh: 第一季完。第二季：爱丁堡。
